notes.title: 0.5.6. Update
notes.content:
Dynamic Industry Spawn
Industry spawning is now fully dynamic, with each industry spawned based on existing dependencies. This should ensure there are no industries left without any input or output.

Each map prioritizes spawning at least 1 consumer goods industry and 1 food industry. The rest is randomized.

This applies to end industries, such as gas stations or hospitals as well. But not to city commercial buildings. Those can still spawn without any input on the map.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/9b40af23030e07d19b6d2042207ddc9a17fa4f2e.png"]
Reorder Switching Changes
New Reorder setting was added to rail switching. Apart from setting which elements to add/remove at a station, Reorder now lets you set a specific train configuration to switch to. This can be used to ensure train only picks up a certain maximum number of cars, or to simply change car order in the station. 

*Reorder still requires available switching track, even if no train elements are left at the station.

Base vehicle categories were also added to rail switching options, so train can switch cars based on generic type (hopper,boxcar,etc.), not just a specific car. It is now also possible to switch the main locomotive.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/2bb3aa8a8b3a018ad9ec43916f23e7129ebaa3ab.png"]
Smaller Changes
Few changes were made to the new ResponsiveUI, and a bunch of new world UI elements were added. Mainly new hover widgets and station interaction widgets.

There were also minor rendering changes related to performance, shadow optimization, and reducing ghosting issues.


Fixes
Fixed few issues from previous industry update causing errors.

Fixed ResponsiveUI tab switching when game is paused.

Fixed train path prioritizing secondary tracks and properly ignoring switching tracks.

notes.title: 0.5.3. Industry Update #2
notes.content:
When I said the last industry update was the last, I was very wrong. So here is another one.


Global Electricity
Electricity is now a global commodity. It is produced by power plant industries and consumed by cities and certain high electricity-demanding industries. 

It can't be transported or stored in any way (yet), and immediate electricity production must meet power demand. This will also serve to better utilize other types of power plants in the future. To demonstrate this, BioPlant, producing electricity from biomass, has been added as an alternative to a coal power plant.

All locations producing or consuming electricity can be found in a new World Window UI tab. Industries requiring electricity currently are: 

Aluminum Smelter

Silicon Smelter

Electric Arc Furnace


City Passenger Production
City passenger production is now handled in a similar way to industry production. Default passenger production hovers around 50% and increases with City Growth.

Delivering cargo to towns produces more passengers, delivering those passengers produces even more passengers, and the whole production chain comes full circle.

City Growth is based on the number of requirements each city has. Small village doesn't need electricity, town needs local public transport, and large city will have more commercial demand. This means that a larger city can grow faster than a small village, but it will be harder to keep up with its demand.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/44f3ba14d667668714b1f53c19966c1748eef596.png"]

City UI also has a new tab to list all commercial buildings, what cargo they accept, their stock and consumption. Hovering over commercial building also shows current stock for easier access.


Final Industry Changes
New Cargo

Textile

Biowaste

New Industry

Clothing Factory

Feed Mill

BioPlant

New Textile cargo has been added as an intermediate step. It is produced in previous Textile Mill and consumed in new Clothing Factory, Pharmaceutical Lab and high-level Furniture Factory.

Animal Feed has been split into a separate cargo, and byproduct from agricultural production has been changed to Biowaste. Animal Feed is now produced by new Feed Mill industry, because having Grain as direct supply to animal farms was a bit too easy.

Fixed deleting a city from editor causing issues.

notes.content:
Premade maps and scenarios were added back.

Two optimization changes to improve performance while placing road and rail splines. This includes bridges and tunnels as well.

Rail bridge collision was changed, so it's possible to stack bridges and ramps next to each other.


Testing UI redesign
I have struggled with the UI design for this game since the very beginning and I've wasted months of work on 4 complete redesigns at this point. Even after all this time i'm still not 100% sure if I want to go with a more modern UI feel, or lean into the low-poly aesthetic and try a more 'cartoony' design.

For this iteration I have decided to stick with a modern design, that would be slightly more interesting and dynamic, while still possible to do with no resources. And hopefully different enough from other similar games (I'm looking at you Transport Fever with the most basic window design possible)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/c0d9cee1f9ad5b20ef909b6f273ed5c6e9bb05e7.png"]

New UI is currently being tested on Industry, City and Waypoints to see if any changes need to be made or if I want to stick with it at all. So if you have any strong feelings about the UI design, one way or the other, let me know.

notes.title: 0.5.1 Industry Update
notes.content:
Update overhauling industry setup, new industry cargo classifications, adding new cargo, industries, and bugfixes.


Industry Update
5 new types of cargo and 6 new industries, changes to chemical industry chain, tools and alternative uses of byproducts. This brings us to 59 cargo types and 88 industries in total.

 

New Cargo

Wood Chips

Chemical Minerals

Tools

Lab Equipment

Automation Tools

Animal Feed

 

New Industries

Sulfur Mine (Minerals)

Chemical Plant (Minerals->Chemicals)

OSB Factory (Wood Chips, Chemicals ->Lumber)

Tools Factory (Steel, Wood -> Tools)

Lab Equipment Facility (Glass, Rubber –> Lab Equipment)

Mechatronics Plant (Aluminum, Plastic, Electronic Components -> Automation Tools)

 
New Industry Setup
This update introduces some changes to the industry production cycle itself. New input and output classifications and how it effects production.

INPUT - Base materials needed for industry production.

OPTIONAL INPUT - Some inputs have several cargo options to choose, but only one type of cargo is required.

ADDITIVES - Extra additive cargo needed at higher level. If industry does not have additive cargo, it will still continue to produce, but maximum production will be lowered.

PACKAGING – Most industries producing consumer Goods or Food now require packaging. If industry does not have packaging, it will still continue to produce, but at lower rate indicated in the production bar.

SUPPLIES (previously tools)- Consumable supplies used to boost industry production. Almost all industries now can accept some type of Supplies. This cargo can increase industry maximum production up to 150% and improve production rate increase. Supplies are consumed once a week.

ELECTRICITY - Some industries need active power plant in order to work.

OUTPUT - Products created by the industry.

BYPRODUCT - Additional cargo created during production process in small quantities (<25%). Doesn't have separate production bar and doesn't count towards Transported percentage.

 

Other than Parcels, this should be the final look of the industry setup. Apart from some namechanges or adding or removing an industry here and there.


Copy Map Data
Save game header file now contains map generation data. This can be used to copy saved game map data from a main Load Game menu and paste it into a new terrain generation menu to create the exact same map.

This doesn't work retroactively on maps saved in previous version, and doesn't apply to nature or infrastructure spawning. Only terrain.


Other Changes

Small spline placement performance optimization.

notes.title: 0.5 Core Update
notes.content:
Right, an update. New 0.5 version is here with some major core changes, most of which are not visible or that exciting. 

Warning: This update will definitely break old saves and deleting old save folder is required.

MAJOR CORE UPDATE
Some core game and engine stuff was changed. Not as much as I'd like, but it's something. New camera system, changes to world simulation, faster overall vehicle speed, faster fast-forward simulation, performance improvements, etc.

Cool new main menu was also added, signalling possible future UI redesign.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/f049ad60f2421d50e4c1503f4e7fff801dc3e739.png"]


INDUSTRY UPDATE
Biggest changes are with industry system, bringing 7 new cargos, 15 new industries and some more changes to existing industry chains. 

NEW CARGO

Oilseed

Edible Oil

Petroleum Products

Silicon

Synthetic Rubber

Carbon Black

Tires

Electronic Components

NEW INDUSTRIES

Oilseed Farm

Oilseed Processing Plant

Silicon Smelter

Semiconductor Plant

Cosmetics Factory

Synthetic Rubber Plant

Carbon Black Plant

Tire Manufacturing Plant

Tire Shop

New Food Processing Variants 

Canning Plant

Candy Factory

Snack Factory

Meat Packaging Plant

Food Processing Plant

Dairy Plant

Small changes to petrochemical and electronics industry chains. Oil Refinery now produces Petroleum Products, Solar Panel Factory uses Silicon instead of sand, Car Assembly Plant now requires tires and Electronics were changed to Electronic Components and Electronics Factory now produces Cargo.

Several new Food Processing Plant variants were added, so each food-related cargo has at least 2 possible industry uses.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/baa7fec9b6dc6cbfa8f531777157ef54db35cca8.png"]

City-cargo setup has also changed, with each commercial building now accepting its own cargo, rather than just entire city accepting any cargo. Right now most buildings still accept cargo or food, but the plan is for each commercial building to accept different kinds of cargo. Restaurant accepting food, hardware store accepting tools, pharmacy accepting... you get the idea.

This was done to give more types of cargo utility as a city delivery and also to give more utility to small trucks, which were kind of useless.



Final industry changes should be coming in the new few weeks.

notes.title: 0.4.5. Infrastructure Update
notes.content:
Last few months have been an absolute nightmare, so let me start by apologizing for the lack of updates and then rant a bit about the current changes in what is the largest update so far.

Warning: This update will definitely break old saves and deleting old save folder is strongly recommended. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/fee1e6b6a10c52225129e81b21ca2bff8495c6fb.png
FINISHING PASSENGER UPDATE
Last finishing touches on passenger update with passenger Comfort Level and multi-cargo passenger vehicles.

When I was working on the Amrtrak update I became fascinated with how US handles long-distance passenger trains and wanted to incorporate it into the gameplay somehow. It’s finally here as a passenger Comfort Level – each passenger vehicle has a certain level of comfort, which increases passenger delivery time and thus making long-distance transport more viable. With 0 comfort being default delivery time and 100 being 2x delivery time. 

US passenger railcars now come in multiple options with different capacity and comfort level. Some railcars, like cafés and diners have limited capacity, but provide a comfort level bonus to the entire train.
Coach – High capacity, normal comfort level.
Sleeper – Low capacity, very high comfort level.
Cafe/Lounge – Medium capacity, moderate comfort level bonus.
Diner – No capacity, high comfort level bonus.

This allows you to combine different railcar types based on distance, with coaches and cafés for short-distance travel and sleepers + diners for long distances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/b9269e2676f0e28413a840a82f32111bca3f300d.png
Other part of the passenger changes is passenger vehicles capable of carrying multiple cargo types. First one is split passenger/baggage cars. Second one is local passenger vehicles, like city buses or commuter railcars, with seated and standing passenger capacities. Only local passengers can be transported as standing passengers and provide no comfort.

BRIDGES AND INTERSECTIONS
Both rail and road bridges are now splines, instead of tiles. This removes a lot of the restrictions of straight tile bridges and allows you to create any custom curved bridges you desire. Bridge type selection was also changed as a separate window that appears after bridge is placed, with available types based on current bridge specifics. Pretty much the same as any other transport game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/4c708d988d6efe4a028272d38eb5b889e530a53d.png
Road system was changed to allow all kinds of intersections, not just 90° crossroads. Roads cannot overlap more than 2 road segments and cannot overlap 1x1 street tiles (because those need to create crossroads).
Although there is currently no limit to how many roads can be connected to the same point, technically there can only be 3 roads connections – left, right and center. Additional roads will simply not count as a valid connected road.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/55598ea476847a39374f64587165b7e00844a486.png
Rail placement and collision was also reworked, so junctions no longer block placement of a new track.

RAIL STATION CHANGES
Railway station layout was changed, with all station types now sharing the same size and layout, to allow for easy editing of existing railway stations. Now you can easily change size, add or remove tracks or change station type. All can be done from the station window under the Edit Layout option.

New railway station type - Loading yard was also added. This station is designed to handle various break-bulk cargo that would be handled by crane or doesn’t fit in other station types. Currently it handles metals, wood, lumber, sugar beets and scrap. It also comes with different visual options, also selectable from the layout options. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/09a21908b9355d18a8af6c5b3d1718f6c668508e.png
This station type is also first to test setup for visible cargo waiting in station. It is using the most basic setup I could think of, so I want to see if or how much it affects performance before it will be expanded to other stations and cargo types.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/ef4ed5e9be7da4942f5e79e011e6d21632dc4970.png
Passenger railway station visuals were also heavily redesigned.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/17cd97343f9e0add1c2ac3f68247905486b7d351.png

RAILWAY PATHTRACING
Now to the most exhausting part of the update. Railway pathtracing was completely re-done from the ground up, with new pathtracing algorithm itself, new way to store and access data at runtime, better way to check valid paths, change tracks, the whole thing. 

The result is immensely faster and better optimized pathtracing that works surprisingly well even on super large rail networks.

It is still work in progress and there are definitely things that can be improved. But if everything works, this system should be implemented into road pathtracing as well, which would be fantastic and it is a much needed step towards large-scale maps.

Trains simulation model was also changed slightly. For all the train nerds out there, it is now running on a needlessly accurate 1992 Davis model, with more accurate coefficients adjusted dynamically based on railcar load. The result is slightly less power usage for empty freight trains, slightly more power usage for full freight trains, and much less power usage for streamlined passenger trains.
Tldr: Freight trains should be slightly slower, passenger trains a lot faster.

FIXES AND NEW VEHICLES
- Fixed car pathtracing issue with road stops with multiple stops.
- Fixed several issues with rail signal behavior. 
- Fixed few smaller issues with road placement and collisions. 
And a bunch of smaller stuff I have honestly lost track of.

A bunch of new US buses were added. 1 local and 5 intercity in total.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/04ae7ed95a05651ae815489a405a0149acffcaeb.png
New modern passenger trains.

 SC-44 ‚Charge‘ locomotive
 Venture passenger cars

New fictional futuristic passenger cars

 Explorer passenger cars (replacing Viewliner line)
 Solaris passenger cars (replacing Superliner line)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/a07967dbce4d24884562b8dc8b1835425734e399.png

That is it for this update. Now if you'll excuse me, I need to go scream into a pillow for a few days.

notes.title: Passenger Update
notes.content:
So many things to do, so not enough of anything else...

DESTINATION SYSTEM
City-based transport now uses a new Destination System. Intercity passengers and some other city-based cargo now spawn separately for each destination. Destination passengers or cargo need to be delivered to the correct destination to be accepted. 
Destination system can be fully combined with the current order system, to easily create specific lines for each destination, create passenger transfer stations, or let the system decide automatically.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/ebf22494a174e18054c744f6bd9a29a6eedeb112.png
Total number of intercity passengers spawned by a city remains the same, but individual spawn rate for each destination is now based on Destination Population and Growth, not just origin city population. This means that a small city might produce more passengers to a large city, than large city to small one, which might not be as intuitive at first and lead to more asymmetrical transport, which is always fun. 

Local passengers remain the same.

Current Limitations
There is only one Destination setting shared by all cargo in Vehicle Orders. If you want to use any way to limit cargo transport, like Per Cargo option, this setting will apply to all destination cargo. F.E. you cannot transport passengers only from town A to town B, while also transporting mail only from town A to town C. (Unless you use individual Per Car options)

If using any way to limit cargo transfer, like Station Transfer or Per Cargo setting, both Destination and Cargo type options have to be enabled for cargo to succesfully transfer.

NEW CITY CARGO
Two new city-based cargo types have been added. Baggage and Mail.

Baggage is rail-only cargo, spawning concurrently with intercity passengers, but transported by specific railcars. Baggage spawn rate is based on distance to destination. Increasing with further distance, with almost no baggage spawning for destinations within 64 tiles.

Mail spawns and is accepted by Post Office (which currently looks like a previous town hall, until I can make something more appropriate). Mail is also a destination cargo, so it spawns separately for each destination and spawns based on destination population and growth. Mail can currently be transported by new railcars (same as baggage) or trucks (not trailers). Cannot be transported by ships.

FERRY TRANSPORT
Speaking of ships... Ferries have finally been added!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/54cfad028341d942392893d880ae41cde6999db9.png
New transport option with 3 new ferry types, from small car ferry to massive cruise ferry and more models will be added gradually. Ferries also have new Ferry Port type with different design.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/2be1d03f255959566d8b7938eb9cb30e621bf582.png

IMPROVEMENTS AND FIXES

 Added option to upgrade and destroy road/track in segments. (currently with CTRL)
 Added option to delete cargo from station. (Station can't be accepting cargo and Accept option has to be set to Never in the Transfer window) 
 Passenger Stations now load/unload 3 cars at once.
 Fixed some problems with overtaking detection on multi-trailer trucks and collision detection on multi-lane curve roads. Parallel lanes now shouldn't block collision.
 Fixed multi-trailer trucks depot parking and some issues with depot leaving.
 Fixed issue with ship pathtracing when multiple ports are placed right next to each other.
 Fixed few issues with train stopping at a depot, adding depot order while train is moving and few issues with depot Preset Orders.
 Fixed issue with signals letting multiple trains through at the same time, caused in previous update.


MORE US RAILCARS
Continuing to add new US-style railcars into the mix. This time new F59PHI loco, a bunch of passenger and baggage cars, gondolas and centerbeams.

notes.title: Amtrak Update
notes.content:
First part of larger passenger update. Finishing last orders improvements with stop frequency and switch condition, changing vehicle rebuilds, adding first Amtrak locomotives, Amfleet coaches, and an assortment of US-style hoppers. 

Stop Frequency
Stop frequency can now be set for each station. Vehicle will only stop at the station every n-th specified time. Currently can be set up to 24, or 1 by default. 
This can be used to easily setup routes with less frequent stops, without having to cycle route orders multiple times. Can also be used to setup maintenance stops, when vehicle condition is fully implemented.
- Pathtracing will currently not automatically check for paths of skipped stations when new destination is selected. Make sure vehicle has a path to the skipped station and to the next station before sending vehicle on the route.

Switching Condition
Switching can be set as either Switch Any or Switch All. Similar to loading condition, vehicle will either switch any elements available in the station and leave, or wait in the station until all set elements have been switched.

Vehicle Rebuilds
Naming changed from Modernization to Rebuilds. With new vehicles and new rebuild options being added, vehicle rebuild system has been changed. Vehicles can no longer be rebuilt from their own Control Window. Instead, rebuilds can now be accessed from main Vehicles Window or from Depot Window. New Rebuilds tab now displays all available rebuilds, can be sorted by vehicle type, and has the option to rebuild all vehicles at once.

Fixes
- Fixed bug with train stopping when new track junction is placed while train is passing rail signal. 
- Fixed switching track overflow when using 'ordered' sorting.
- Fixed several issues with vehicles not finding a path to depot or restarting after being sent to depot.
- Fixed inaccurate space adjustments when reversing a train, leading to some trains breaking after reverse.
- Fixed few rail signal issues when creating level 'diamond' crossing and with signals at both ends of a 90° track.
- Fixed visual bug with train station not updating properly when switching a type.

New US vehicles
Continuing to add new US vehicles, this time focusing on passenger trains and hopper cars.

Locomotives

 F40PH
 F40PH-2
 AEM-7

notes.title: 0.4 Cleanup Update
notes.content:
I needed to have this update out by the end of June. Which didn’t happen. At all. So let’s hope late is still better than never.

Finishing Save System
Previous version switched to using single-file saves, which I was quite proud of, but I was really hoping the single-file system would work a lot better than it was. I have spend way too much time trying to make it work, but there was still a noticeable performance hit when creating/opening menu that I could not get rid of. So 0.4 version is going back to using 2 file save system, which I really hate, but don’t have a lot of choice anymore. 

Game will now save with *.sav file and *.h.sav preview file. The .h file is not needed to load the game and if it’s not present, the game will just use the slower loading method. So if you are one of the amazing people sending bug-related save files and such, you can still just send the main file.

Previous files still work, old 0.3 save files will just keep causing the menu to load slower. All you have to do is resave with the current version and main menu and save/load menu will work much faster.

Finalizing Orders
Preset order options were reworked quite a bit. Some options were simplified while adding new options, to make preset orders more versatile. 
Vehicle Refit was removed. Restricting vehicle cargo can now be done only with Per Cargo options.
Per Car and Switch options were changed and moved to a separate pop-up window.

I’m quite happy with the current orders structure and what they offer now. Other than a few layout changes and one or two minor additions, this should be the final look and they should not change anymore.

Switching Yards
One of the features that changed the most in this update was train switching. Switching previously worked with direct vehicle references, which was very limiting and overcomplicated. Instead, switching can now be used to add or remove train elements in station based on set of conditions. 

[previewyoutube=aMZkL6lhkmM;full][/previewyoutube]
Current conditions are vehicle type, cargo type, and cargo load. This means that you can have one train come into a station, offload all full oil tankers, and have different train come in, pick up full oil tankers, and continue to another station, without having to transfer any cargo to or from the station. Essentially creating fully functional switching (shunting) yards!
Switching can also be used to reorder trains in station, but switching track is sill required for this.

Creating switching yards was one of the original goals for this game and I’m very happy with how this works right now. With the current order changes, everything is a lot easier to set up.

Line Manager & Cargo Guide
Lines – new order option was added. Lines can be created and edited from Line Manager tab in the Vehicles window and then simply select the desired line in the vehicle Orders tab. Advantages of using lines instead of individual vehicle orders are the option to easily edit orders for all vehicles on a line and see financial statistics of entire line, including stations.
Current Line limitations are inability to use Per Car options and inability to display path highlight when placing an order.

Cargo Guide and Industry Chains guide were added to highlight the nightmare that is Transporters industry chains. 
Cargo guide can be opened by clicking on any cargo type in the UI and shows what industries produce and consume said cargo, what stations handle it, what vehicles transport it, as well as some technical details, such as actual cargo payment or delivery time.

Interactive industry chains show all cargo, suppliers and consumers for each industry, including optional changes based on industry level.

Small Changes, Tutorials & Future Updates
Related to switching yard changes, railway track rendering was reworked to greatly improve performance, especially with massive railway stations.

Also added a preview when buying or reordering a vehicle in a depot, to show new vehicle stats without having to mouse over it.

There is one more round of tutorials coming at some point, going over more advanced order options, creating transfer stations and setting up switching yards.

There was a few things I wasn’t able to finish in time, that should be coming out in the near future. Adding more vehicles, new transport options, such as ferries and planes. Few infrastructure changes, like connecting multiple roads and spline-based bridge placement. The aim is to have a more complete version of the game by September.

notes.title: Version 0.3 Update
notes.content:
I have emerged out of my sleepless nightmare once again, to deliver an update. This time adding new save system, large maps, vehicle modernization and condition and a couple of new industries, vehicles, and fixes.

SERIALIZED SAVE SYSTEM and LARGE MAPS
Brand new serialized saving system, which I didn’t want to do initially, but it was the only way to make large maps usable. This should make saving and loading a bit faster, drastically reduce save file size (forested 768 map file is still under 50MB, which I am very happy about), and be a bit more reliable on large maps.

This allowed me to finally enable large 512x512 and even 768x768 maps, with the only limiting factor right now being the map generation time.

I have also added new map climate selection window and first new map environment – Mediterranian climate. The differences right now are mostly just visual (with a new pine forest type), but the plan is to have each environment with some unique industries and different set of vehicles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/6d2aeb03ed64f5eb8049c9c4839ebddc94437de2.png
*Old Save files should still be able to load with this system, but some elements, like depot connections or cargo stored in stations might not work properly, so starting a new game is recommended.

VEHICLE MODELS, MODERNIZATION and CONDITION
Added vehicle models and modernization option.
Vehicle models give me a way to add new vehicles without clogging the purchase window with a bunch of vehicles that look almost exactly the same.

If vehicle gets a new model, you will only be able to purchase this new model from now on, but older vehicles with new model option can be rebuilt/modernized to this new model with only a small cost. Vehicle can be modernized either from the depot window or from directly from the vehicle window for a small fee. 

For example, locomotives GP7, 8 and 9 are visually almost identical, with only small stat differences, but the vehicle was in service for a very long time, so it makes sense to have an option to modernize older, especially starter, vehicles. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/0f9a65b7123d7df1bc6915ee99f707dd0ac81b76.png

Vehicles now have Reliability score, Lifespan and can break down.
Chance for a vehicle to break down is a combination of reliability, lifespan and vehicles current condition, although current condition does not change right now. Until I figure out how I want to handle maintenance.

Editable railway station platforms.
As the first part of trying to make stations layout completely editable, players can now edit railway station platform layout. It's currently limited to only couple of station types for testing and can be accessed from the main station window with EDIT LAYOUT button.
This will add an option to change stations visual style (if thats something you’re interested in), save current layout and give me an option to easily add different station types in the future. Right now there is a few different options for liquid-bulk stations and a grain loading station for dry-bulk.

A lot of this stuff is still setting up the framework for what I hope the full release can be.

NEW CARGO, INDUSTRY and VEHICLES
Added new cargo – Packaging
I wasn’t sure if I wanted to add this, but I decided to test it out and see how it works. Packaging now replaces raw materials, like plastics or paper in a few industries where it makes sense for packaging to be used. Right now it's Food Processing Plant, Chemical Factory, Brewery/Cider Mill, Goods Factory and higher levels of Poultry Farm.

Packaging is produced by new industry – Packaging plant and needs Paper, Plastics, Glass OR Aluminum (1 or more components) and is transported by box cars.

 Added Ceramics plant. Ceramics plant needs clay and makes Cargo and Construction materials.
 Added Industrial Bakery, which was missing from the industry chain. Bakery needs Flour (on higher levels also Sugar and Milk) and makes Food. Model is currently just a re-skinned food processing plant.
 Set up Car Factory, Car Dealership, and truck car trailers with cargo. This was in the game before, but wasn’t properly set up, so industries producing and consuming cars will now spawn on the map.
 Changed industry spawning system, so industries are less likely to spawn duplicates. City-related industries, like hospital or car dealership will be forced to always spawn on the map if they are a part of an industry chain.
 Added new starting locomotive GP7.
 Added new mainline electric locomotives WAG-9 and WAP-7.
 Added ER2 trainset.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/b0bc481ac73f9ed46ea0c762db323cd1e9e3104e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/e1bdc5cdf62f70daff3be04be96fb86ec2fb4b8b.png
OTHER ADDITIONS

 Added a topographic map layer in the layers menu for easier terrain editing and navigating through forests.
 New water shader and reflections.
 Added new tooltip for industries with more than 1 optional cargo component (most of them require 1 or more components, construction yard requires 2 or more components)

FIXES

 Fixed several issues with re-pathtracing and changing path after vehicle was active.
 Fixed few issues with road vehicles getting stuck in station and moving road vehicle to depot while it's parking, but not fully in station (probably related to the same issue) 
 Fixed road waypoints loading on spline road segments.

notes.title: Career Update
notes.content:
New month is here and with it a new update! Version 0.2 is adding new gameplay layer with career mode, research and progression system.
Career mode
Create your own transport company in the Career mode and build your way from a few old trucks to a Logistics Enterprise with the latest, cutting-edge technological advancements.
Start only with limited number of vehicles and unlock new options through game progression and research. 
Freeplay mode stays the same, with all transport options unlocked from the start. Switching to Editor is disabled in Career mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/8add3283c92b34a940fdd040a4633184216249b6.png
Research & Expertise

 Company can gain expertise by delivering cargo. Expertise affects prices and building costs and a certain level of expertise is often required for additional research. 
 Research unlocks certain buildings, improvements, and new transport options. Most research has multiple steps to complete and requires significant amount of time and money.

New technology breakthroughs – such as Maglev or AVs – are unlocked through research. Additional vehicles are then unlocked automatically as time progresses.
Current research options are not final. Over 80 Research nodes and 20 Station upgrades are in right now and there is still more on the way.
Progression system

 Stations can level up and gain experience from loading, unloading, or selling cargo. With each level, station will receive a point to spend on one-time upgrades, increasing station stats.
 Vehicles can level up and gain experience from reaching a station and delivering cargo. With each level, vehicle will slightly increase stats, but increase operating costs.
 Industries have a chance to get a random upgrade when leveling up.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/073c5a0dae3fc029ec50c29a6d23addb9d28f4f8.png
Other additions

 New company UI window with options to change company name or color scheme – including custom color picker - and track company score.
 Added a simple loan system. Loan amount is limited based on map size.
 Added a simple local rating, allowing to demolish town buildings if the rating is high enough.
 Added ‚Preset‘ Orders – Simplified, premade orders to choose from instead of the full order options. Presets are on by default, but player can still switch to full order options if needed. This was made mostly to make orders a bit less confusing for new players, so I’ll see if it sticks.
 Added option to copy orders from other vehicle.
 Added keybinds to ‚Pause menu‘ and ‚Close Last Window‘ and added ‚Menu‘ buttom on screen.
 Added 2 new locomotives - CHME3 in Ukrainian livery and CHME3M in Latvian(ish) livery 
 Added vehicle VFX.
 Added 11 new music tracks.
 New UI when placing new station showing what cargo station can accept or sell and from which industry.
 New UI when moused over buildings showing – station capacity, industry production/stock, city population
 Highlighting connected stations when placing new station.
 Vehicle profits are now calculated for each vehicle that transported cargo based on the distance it traveled.
 Minor UI changes, mainly to make the main toolbar smaller and less obstructive.
 Some minor graphical improvements.
Fixes

 Improved railway placing performance and fixed grid snapping.
 Railway now snaps to other nearby tracks when placing.
 Fixed upgrading road connected to a station.
 Fixed road depot not connecting properly on load game.
 Fixed ship depot not deleting vehicles.
 Fixed road depot duplicating trailers.
 Fixed notifications and music menu controls.

... and some other minor fixes I forgot to write down. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/c68191112feb8d0ed7a1daa18ebc85b8762e1123.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708874/63f0ca460aa5c827d8ddb11e71a26b4e45facd59.png

Insane amount of work went into the last couple of updates, and there is still so much more to come, so if you have any interest in what this is becoming, please consider giving this a shot.
If you are discouraged by the lack of communication/social media engagement and such, please know that it’s only because ALL of my time is spent working on the game itself.
